    Timeline

    • items.list List timeline items
    • items.get Get a timeline item
    • items.create Create a timeline item
    • items.update Update a timeline item

    items.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/items MCP items_list

    List timeline items

    Timeline items (milestones, releases, features...). Filter by project (id or name), kind, status or q (title contains). Items with start "" are backlog.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    projectstringProject id or name.
    kindenumOne of feature, milestone, release, deadline, project, phase, event.
    statusenumOne of planned, active, risk, blocked, done, cancelled.
    qstring
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Project id or name."
    },
    "kind": {
      "enum": [
        "feature",
        "milestone",
        "release",
        "deadline",
        "project",
        "phase",
        "event"
      ]
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "planned",
        "active",
        "risk",
        "blocked",
        "done",
        "cancelled"
      ]
    },
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    itemsobject[]required
    items[].idstringrequired
    items[].titlestringrequired
    items[].kindenumrequiredOne of feature, milestone, release, deadline, project, phase, event.
    items[].statusenumrequiredOne of planned, active, risk, blocked, done, cancelled.
    items[].startstringrequired
    items[].endstringrequired
    items[].prioritystring
    items[].releasestring
    items[].projectsstring[]required
    items[].ownerstring
    items[].linkstring
    items[].notesstring
    nextCursorstring | nullrequired
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    JSON Schema

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "kind": {
            "enum": [
              "feature",
              "milestone",
              "release",
              "deadline",
              "project",
              "phase",
              "event"
            ]
          },
          "status": {
            "enum": [
              "planned",
              "active",
              "risk",
              "blocked",
              "done",
              "cancelled"
            ]
          },
          "start": {
            "type": "string"
          },

            "type": "string"

            "type": "string"

            "type": "string"
          },
          "projects": {
            "type": "array",

              "type": "string"

          "owner": {
            "type": "string"

            "type": "string"

    Example: Releases

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/items?kind=release" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "i1",
      "title": "Public beta",
      "kind": "release",
      "status": "planned",
      "start": "2026-12-01",
      "end": "",
      "priority": "",
      "release": "",
      "projects": [
        "p1"
      ],
      "owner": "",
      "link": "",
      "notes": ""
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}

    items.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/items MCP items_create

    Create a timeline item

    Add a timeline item. Without a start date it is backlog (Board and List only). Kind defaults to milestone when dated, feature otherwise.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    titlestringrequired
    kindenumOne of feature, milestone, release, deadline, project, phase, event.
    statusenumOne of planned, active, risk, blocked, done, cancelled.
    startstringYYYY-MM-DD, or "" for none.
    endstringYYYY-MM-DD, or "" for none.
    priorityenumOne of high, medium, low, ``.
    releasestringA release item: id or title; "" for none.
    projectsstring[]
    ownerstring
    linkstring
    notesstring
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "kind": {
      "enum": [
        "feature",
        "milestone",
        "release",
        "deadline",
        "project",
        "phase",
        "event"
      ]
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "planned",
        "active",
        "risk",
        "blocked",
        "done",
        "cancelled"
      ]
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})?$",
      "description": "YYYY-MM-DD, or \"\" for none."
    },
    "end": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})?$",
      "description": "YYYY-MM-DD, or \"\" for none."
    },
    "priority": {
      "enum": [
        "high",
        "medium",
        "low",
        ""
      ]
    },
    "release": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 0,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "A release item: id or title; \"\" for none."
    },
    "projects": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 50,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 200,
        "description": "Project id or name."
      }
    },
    "owner": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 120
    },
    "link": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 500
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 4000
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "title"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Example: A release

    curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Public beta","kind":"release","start":"2026-12-01","projects":["Lantern"]}'
    {
  "rev": 49,
  "item": {
    "id": "i1",
    "title": "Public beta",
    "kind": "release",
    "status": "planned",
    "start": "2026-12-01",
    "end": "",
    "priority": "",
    "release": "",
    "projects": [
      "p1"
    ],
    "owner": "",
    "link": "",
    "notes": ""
  }
}

    items.update write

    PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/items/{item} MCP items_update

    Update a timeline item

    Change any field of a timeline item. Fields left out stay; projects replaces the list.

  -d '{"status":"done"}'

  "rev": 50,

    "id": "i1",

    "start": "2026-12-01",
    "end": "",
